page.title: Now Playing
page.purpose: Play music well, and make the reason this track is playing available without demanding attention. This is the page that must feel like a music player first and a system second.

priorities.statement: Playback control is never blocked by analysis, recommendation, or generation state.
The reason this track is playing is one gesture away, and it is the truth — the contributions shown are the ones that produced the ranking.
A generated track is identifiable as generated without the listener asking, and without relying on colour alone.
Every attribute named in the explanation can be acted on from where it is named.

states.description: Playing a track from the listener's own files.
Track chosen for uncertainty rather than predicted preference.
Playing a track the decomposition pass has not reached yet.

elements.description: Opens the explanation for the current track.
The attribute contributions that produced this recommendation.
Marks a track chosen for exploration rather than predicted preference.

claims.statement: A generated track always exposes its disclosure while playing.
The explanation for the current track is reachable from the player.
A track chosen for exploration says so rather than presenting as a confident recommendation.
Each attribute named in the explanation exposes controls to act on it.
Transport controls remain operable while a track is still unanalysed.
